verdicts.overall: approve_with_notes — H05 may proceed on all six hypotheses; the notes below become CONDITIONS at the stated downstream gates

findings.severity: major (conditional gate, not an H05 blocker)
findings.finding: The turn-aware flow kernel path (_accumulate_od_flow_turns) is uncovered by traces, goldens, or the battery (corpus runs turns=False). All campaign workloads run turns=False, so H05 profiling/admission is unaffected; but DECISION.md requires the proof reviewer to approve the admitted domain and test matrix, and campaign protected cells include turns on/off.
findings.evidence: H03 oracle_manifest.json limitations_and_gaps[0]; workloads.json (all workloads turns=False); VALIDATION.md L2 protected cells.
findings.required_fix: At F1R/F2R/F3R admission approval: each dossier must PROVE its source closure excludes _accumulate_od_flow_turns and the shared flow driver, OR commission an H03 turns supplement (fixture + trace + golden for the turns path) before its candidate can leave review_pending. Until then any candidate touching shared flow driver code is review-gated, not blocked for H05.

findings.finding: Installed-mode identity guards were validated only against a physically laid-out synthetic venv (stub package + dist-info), never against a real built wheel. HARNESS.md req 2 and BENCHMARKS installed-path screening depend on the guard holding for real wheel layouts (data dirs, .data subpaths, RECORD entries).
findings.evidence: H02 protocol.json limitations[9]; test_identity_guard.py synthetic layouts.
findings.required_fix: W00 must include an explicit real-wheel guard proof (run.py installed mode against the actual built B0 wheel, plus one tamper probe) and record it; until then no installed-qualified record exists (the harness already structurally refuses installed records without wheel identity, which contains the blast radius).

findings.finding: Dedicated per-pool thread inspection (Arrow, turn/cluster pools) is captured only indirectly via the Settings echo; HARNESS.md req 3 names them explicitly, and numba-specific effective counts are observed but asserted by no test.
findings.evidence: H02 protocol.json limitations[2], sampled_vs_enforced entries; inspect_thread_pools records numba + BLAS env only.
findings.required_fix: Before S01 (scheduling selection) and before F1 admission evidence is accepted (DECISION.md: F1 requires observed serialization/low concurrent kernel execution — decorator inspection insufficient), H05 profiling records must be supplemented with a direct per-pool inventory (threadpoolctl-style or explicit executor objects) captured identically in both arms. Does not block starting H05.

findings.finding: VALIDATION.md L1 requires kernel-boundary checks on actual typed arrays captured from the observed B0 topology (incl. int32 endpoint inputs) and validation of ALL specializations used by final workloads. H03 covers L0 corpus + L1 determinism (double runs, thread counts, arm-vs-arm) and a specialization inventory from the corpus, but no observed-typed-array kernel boundary tests exist yet.
findings.evidence: H03 oracle_manifest comparison_scope + limitations (corpus <=~200 nodes); VALIDATION.md L1.
findings.required_fix: Before A1R/A2R/A3R/F1R/F2R/F3R approvals, capture observed-scale typed arrays from a B0 O2/O3 pass and run candidate-vs-B0 kernel comparisons on them. Partial mitigation already exists: this reviewer's observed-scale double run (observed_l2.json) proves B0-vs-B0 bit-identity of the engine-level outputs (C/F layouts both exercised) across fresh processes.

findings.finding: F2 stale-scratch inertness (no dd_buf/pd_buf reset between ODs) is proven only at corpus scale via a geometric argument; the F2 reset obligation is enforced by journal + code review, not output bytes. A candidate that silently REMOVES a needed reset at observed scale would not be caught by output comparison at corpus scale.
findings.required_fix: F2R review must explicitly re-verify the geometric inertness argument at O3_FLOW scale (or add one observed-scale scratch-journal probe). No H05 blocker.

findings.finding: Worker-side stuck-result-channel path (put deadline then exit 73) is implemented but exercised by no test; deadlock-freedom is structural (bounded maxsize + interleaved drain) plus the slow-drain input-queue test. Warm-up record fields (warmup_ns, warmup hashes) are recorded but asserted by no test.
findings.required_fix: Acceptable to proceed; if any H05 run exhibits writer/queue anomalies, add the two tests before relying on those paths in qualification.

findings.finding: ODM dispatcher path is mock/stub-tested only; the real-engine ODM path was never executed in H02. RunODM is outside the six-hypothesis portfolio and all current workloads, so nothing in H05 depends on it.
findings.required_fix: Keep RunODM out of any qualified claim until a real-engine ODM diagnostic exists; no action needed for H05.

findings.finding: identity_sha256 is an unkeyed canonical-JSON integrity hash; macOS USS/PSS unavailable to non-root (sampler falls back to RSS, declared conservative, identical both arms); cold-process compile-cold semantics rely on operator-supplied fresh --cache-root (harness never wipes caches). All three are declared honestly in protocol.json.
findings.required_fix: None required; conditions already stated. Reviewer confirms the declarations match the code.

findings.severity: minor (recorded B0 behavior, not a defect to fix)
findings.finding: Two inherited state quirks observed at O2 scale: (a) UNA.has_flow_results is never set True by RunFlow (engine-level flow.has_flow_results carries the state); (b) RunAccessibility does not clear a previous RunFlow's stored engine/results (stale una.flow remains). Also RunFlow re-reads the full network GeoJSON on the same object (arrays rebound, V/E deterministic 49159/69957).
findings.required_fix: None — B0 behavior is preserved by contract. Candidate reviews must NOT count these as candidate regressions, and chronology comparisons must expect them on both arms.
